name: harbor-long
description: Drift test: eight 5 s continue joins (about 38 s, one take). Does the boat, light and colour hold to the end?

shots.prompt: A small blue fishing boat returns to harbor at golden hour, gulls circling overhead, gentle waves, the low hum of the boat's engine, wide shot
The small blue fishing boat glides past the stone lighthouse at the harbor entrance, golden hour light, gulls calling, the engine humming, camera follows slowly
The small blue fishing boat slows beside a wooden dock, ripples spreading across calm water, warm golden light, gulls landing on the dock posts, the engine idling
The engine of the small blue fishing boat falls quiet, the boat rocks gently at the wooden dock, the sun touches the horizon, gulls settle, soft lapping water
The small blue fishing boat rests at the wooden dock as the sun sinks below the horizon, orange sky fading to pink, soft lapping water, distant gulls
Dusk over the harbor, the small blue fishing boat moored at the wooden dock, the first harbor lights turning on, calm water reflecting pink and purple sky
Blue hour in the harbor, the small blue fishing boat silhouetted at the dock, lighthouse beam sweeping slowly, gentle water sounds
Night falls over the quiet harbor, the small blue fishing boat still at the wooden dock, stars appearing, the lighthouse beam turning, soft waves
